purpose: Gas-phase CH3O reference for T1.18 adsorption energy (vacuum convention).
note: CH3O radical (open-shell doublet, S=1/2). POSCAR sort=True order = C H H H O; MAGMOM places unpaired μ on O. NUPDOWN=1 enforces total moment = 1 μ_B.
workflow_before_submit: This is a STATIC (NSW=0) box-size sanity check. Before submitting, copy the CONTCAR from ../CH3O_vacuum/ (the 15 Å relaxed geometry) into this dir's POSCAR, then submit. This isolates the cell-size effect from any geometry drift. Target: |E(20.0 Å) − E(15 Å)| < 5 meV.
